CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content is present; A is absent.

COD.rationale: Content (red/blue positions), an explicit organization/origin record, and a separate origin/status field are present for the same candidate referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim linked to a content's organization/access is present.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colored items and their coordinate positions.

D.rationale: Entries pair identified content positions with separate origin/status metadata for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: Explicit organization/presentation metadata (origin, inherited_current, executed_branch_claim) describe how contents are represented or emerge.
